summary: BC OnLine's earlier logo — the hand-and-screen emblem, alone in blue (July 2005) and with the wordmark in black (April 2011) — as supplied vector reconstructions from the service's own PDFs. The reference images are kept in reference/. The service's later logo on the BC mark is the gallery's composed one-off (bc-online).

assets.label: BC OnLine — Hand and screen emblem, 2005
assets.dateNote: The newsletter’s date, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: A hand reaching through a computer screen to its keyboard, drawn in tapered blue strokes: BC OnLine’s emblem, alone.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied reconstruction: 27 hand-drawn Bézier shapes after the newsletter’s small image (no automatic tracing), in its blue (#333B97). Fine detail is interpreted.

assets.label: BC OnLine — Wordmark and emblem, 2011
assets.sourceLocator: Website use terms and conditions, April 2011, page 1 letterhead (a 672 × 145 image)
assets.dateNote: The document’s date, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: “BC OnLine” in broad, slightly inclined capitals, beside the hand-and-screen emblem, in black: the service’s letterhead logo.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied reconstruction: eight hand-drawn letter outlines and the emblem redrawn at the letterhead’s lighter weight, after the document’s image (no automatic tracing). The typeface is not identified.
